quranTranslation.text: But they were froward, so We sent on them the flood of 'Iram, and in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit, the tamarisk and here and there a lote-tree.

explanation.bs: O narodu Sebe: „… a umjesto njihova dva vrta dali smo im dva vrta s gorkim plodom …“ – zemaljski vrtovi; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Of Sheba: “in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit” — earthly gardens; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: If only, when thou enteredst thy garden, thou hadst said: That which Allah willeth (will come to pass)! There is no strength save in Allah! Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children,

explanation.bs: U priči o dvojici ljudi: „Zašto, kad si ušao u svoj vrt, nisi rekao: ‚Biva ono što Allah hoće‘ …“ – vrt s drvećem i plodovima; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: In the parable of the two men: “If only, when thou enteredst thy garden, thou hadst said: That which Allah willeth” — a garden of trees and fruit; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil);

explanation.bs: „I pohitajte ka oprostu od svoga Gospodara i ka Džennetu širokom koliko nebesa i Zemlja …“ – Džennet, onako kako ga ajet opisuje.
explanation.en: “And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth” — Paradise, as the ayah describes it.

quranTranslation.text: Is not He (best) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards, whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow. Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)!

explanation.bs: „… i spušta vam s neba vodu, pa njome dajemo da niknu voćnjaci puni ljepote …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

explanation.bs: „i voćnjaci gusti“ – među onim što iz zemlje niče kao opskrba ljudima.
explanation.en: “And garden-closes of thick foliage” — among what grows from the earth as provision for people.

explanation.bs: „voćnjaci i vinogradi“ – ono što bogobojazne čeka u Džennetu.
explanation.en: “Gardens [ḥadāʾiq] enclosed and vineyards” — what awaits the God-fearing in Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: As for those who believed and did good works, they will be made happy in a Garden.

explanation.bs: „A oni koji su vjerovali i dobra djela činili bit će na livadi obradovani“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Those who believed and did good works are made glad in a rawḍa, a meadow (Pickthall: ‘a Garden’) — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Thou seest the wrong-doers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them, while those who believe and do good works (will be) in flowering meadows of the Gardens, having what they wish from their Lord. This is the great preferment.

explanation.bs: „… a oni koji su vjerovali i dobra djela činili bit će u livadama džennetskih vrtova …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “while those who believe and do good works (will be) in flowering meadows of the Gardens” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
